knobs.note: BH-5620: the lifetime event count a Sentry issue needs before the lane acts on it. Below it: no ledger row and no model call. Read in bin/lib/sentry-triage.sh as ${SENTRY_TRIAGE_MIN_EVENTS:-3}; outside 1..100000 is one log line and the default.

BH-5620: new tickets the lane may file per UTC day (ledger row sentry-triage-day/<date>). At the cap an issue gets no model call and no row, and is offered again the next day while it is inside the lookback. 0 files no new ticket. Read in bin/lib/sentry-triage.sh as ${SENTRY_TRIAGE_MAX_TICKETS_DAY:-5}.

BH-5620: diagnosis calls the lane may start per UTC day, counted in the day row sentry-triage-day/<date> BEFORE each call. With SENTRY_TRIAGE_MAX_USD this bounds the day's spend at calls x MAX_USD (default 10 x 0.50). At the cap an issue gets no call and no row. 0 makes no call. Read in bin/lib/sentry-triage.sh as ${SENTRY_TRIAGE_MAX_CALLS_DAY:-10}; outside 0..200 is one log line and the default.
BH-5620: the lane reads unresolved issues seen in the last this many hours (query lastSeen:-<H>h). Read in bin/lib/sentry-triage.sh as ${SENTRY_TRIAGE_LOOKBACK_H:-24}.
BH-5620: a new ticket gets the hotfix label only when the issue's events in the last 24 h are over this number. Read in bin/lib/sentry-triage.sh as ${SENTRY_TRIAGE_HOTFIX_EVENTS_24H:-50}.
BH-5620: lane log lines the diagnosis prompt may carry (the ticket body shows 20 at most). 0 sends none. Read in bin/lib/sentry-triage.sh as ${SENTRY_TRIAGE_LOG_LINES:-40}.
BH-5620: log lines whose leading timestamp is within this many minutes of the event's dateCreated are the ones read. Read in bin/lib/sentry-triage.sh as ${SENTRY_TRIAGE_LOG_WINDOW_MIN:-10}.
BH-5620: USD cap on each diagnosis call, passed as AGENT_CALL_BUDGET_USD_SENTRY_TRIAGE. 0 makes no call and writes no row. Read in bin/lib/sentry-triage.sh as ${SENTRY_TRIAGE_MAX_USD:-0.50}.
BH-5620: the Sentry project slug the lane reads. An identity, NOT settable from the control plane. Read in bin/lib/sentry-triage.sh as ${SENTRY_TRIAGE_PROJECT:-cromford-harness}.

0 makes this lane call no model at all. bin/lib/llm-gate.sh refuses BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row, so the stop is visible in the ledger rather than being a lane that went quiet.
Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs this lane may reach. Empty is every rung, i.e. today's ladder unchanged. A rung outside the list is refused before the call.
Dollars this lane may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend, never from the box's own logs/cost.csv.
Test seam: epoch seconds bin/sentry-triage.sh uses as now, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: a file bin/sentry-triage.sh sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.

Test seam gate: bin/sentry-triage.sh honours SENTRY_TRIAGE_NOW and sources SENTRY_TRIAGE_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
